purpose: Teach: 原始/平面/増進/傷害/放火/脅し/蔓延/肝臓

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、原始時代の生活の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered primitive life in your research paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Gentle confirmation rather than interrogation. A beat of attentiveness to the student's work. Calm, steady cadence—the voice of a teacher who has read the paper.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、画家の平面構成の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered painter composition techniques in my research paper.
lines.style: Direct, matter-of-fact response. A slight formality—student speaking to teacher in an academic register. Controlled, precise enunciation. No embellishment, just the facts.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 健康増進プログラムを論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered health promotion programs in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, interested tone. A small pause before the question, as if Asuka is genuinely reflecting on what she read. Warm but professional. Encouraging the student to engage.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、傷害事件の心理学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered the psychology of assault cases in my research paper.
lines.style: Steady, serious register. The weight of the subject matter sits in her delivery—no lightness here. Clear enunciation, grounded tone. Speaking as a young scholar discussing substantive work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 連続放火事件の捜査史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered the investigative history of serial arson cases in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Engaged and thoughtful. Asuka leans in slightly with her voice—genuine interest in this particular topic. Measured pace, each phrase deliberate. The cadence of someone following a student's intellectual thread.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、組織犯罪の脅し構造を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered the extortion structures within organized crime in my research paper.
lines.style: Grounded, serious tone. Speaking about difficult subject matter with scholarly distance and maturity. Clear articulation, no flinching. The composure of a student who has done rigorous work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 感染症の蔓延要因を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered the spread factors of infectious disease in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Reflective, measured cadence. Asuka speaks as if turning over the ideas in her mind as she asks. Warm but professional. A teacher genuinely interested in how a student approached this public health topic.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、肝臓病の予防医学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered preventive medicine approaches to liver disease in my research paper.
lines.style: Direct, final response. A quiet conclusion to the exchange—Sakura answers with the same precision and formality as before. Slight settling in her tone, as if bringing this line of questioning to its natural close.
